t: It’s getting pretty late. We have to go, see you in the house.
h: Tell the brothers that Adamant is calling for them.

t: We cannot repel this attack on our own. We are traders, and though we often take up arms, I doubt that we are capable of handling a threat like this one. We are nothing, really, against these stone monsters. Unless the League and the Empire come to the rescue, we are finished.
Oh... How did I deserve that? My ship is a wreck, half of my team is dead, and the goods! The goods! Everything I worked for so hard... Oh!

Yeah, these look legit. Now the camp is open for you. But let me warn you, this area is for honest and respectable folk only. Try any of that counterfeit stuff here and your ass will be sorry. Okay, move along!
h: Show the papers to Stonesky the Crafty at the Eljune Bazaar.

t: Hey, wait! What was it... ! Or I'll shoot you. Wait! Don't be afraid! I'm kidding, heh.

Hey, wait! What was it... ! Or I'll shoot you. Wait! Don't be afraid! I'm kidding, heh.

I don’t really get why they called me. After all, it's my dad who's a decorated general, so they drag him to all sorts of feasts.

Anyway, I figured I have you to thank for that. Well... I mean, thanks. I can at least get a decent meal out of it. Something that's not cacti or hyenas for a change.

And I wanted to say something. Oh, right! In short, we've dealt with Shrinka - he's gonna have a hard time finding allies from now on.

We'll kick anyone's ass for Skulnar. But he told us to keep a lid on it for now. We have to wait! So it's quiet on Suslanger, and I had nothing to do with the ruckus on Izune - those are not my guys.

Well, call me if you need any help?

Hey, how's it going?  Are they still fighting on Eden? We’ve been sitting too long in the Landfill, chasing worms and beating up the Unyielding. Any minute now, the guys are gonna stir up trouble again. They don't listen to me or Kurgan on the other allods, and on Izune partisans already make regular attacks on the Xadaganians.

It's good that Skulnar has returned at least, maybe things will be quiet for now.
Well, let's have a serious talk...

What? After you saved our lives? We might be anarchists, but we have honor!

You cheered up my warriors, so when the worm knocked you over, they got real angry and managed to chase it away...!

I don’t know what you're looking for in the desert and who this Eladia is, but you and your odd friend can go where you want.

But that doesn't mean we're friends now. If we see you near the landfill, we'll give you the same welcome any other traveler gets, hah!
h: Are you going to take us captive again?

t: Fury is stunned but still breathing. She was the first to rush into battle...

Put on a show and survive!

In short, Kurgan says that a strong storm will begin very soon.

Uro-Boros often creeps through here during a storm. That's why this place is so empty.

Our plan is as simple as our cars, so it can fall apart just as easily!

Just run and jump near Skulnar during this Storm. Uro-Boros will come, and you'll chase it away. Well, Skulnar probably knows what to do with these creatures. Talk to him while we still have time.

That's cool!
Ugh, I think I can feel the earth trembling!

You don't say! The way you dealt with those worms, and Skulnar blowing things up... That's so cool, our guys have never seen anything like it.

They don't just want to make Skulnar their leader - they are ready to call him their father! I'm glad you told me the truth. And Kurgan... The old man doesn't show his joy, but he has lived and breathed this prophecy!

Alright, it's all great, but there's bad news, too.
h: It looks like the prophecy was fulfilled...

t:
The Unyielding. They had an observer with them, and...

It looks like they don't care about the prophecies and the revival of the Legendary Orc. They have new faith there - in themselves and in the Ambrosia.

Don't worry, I'll honor my end of the deal. The Unyielding are our problem now, not yours. But I'm not going to turn down your help.

But we'll talk about that later...

quests: And the Legendary Orc was reborn!

t: For sin is sweet; all condemn it, but all men live in it, only others do it on the sly, and I openly.

r466639.s: Organizer of the Circle of Equals

t:
Yes, the illumined! How many moons have passed since the day you saved Howlem from the creatures of the Void? Impossible to count.

News of your exploits has reached us, eysh! Who would have thought that you could accomplish so much, zur? The storytellers will sing of your deeds for a long time. You a true bayaz!

As for us, until recently we lived our own way. More and more Pridens are sent to conquer the outside world, and on Howlem everything is the same as in the old days. New pups are born, dying and being reborn in the grove of the First. Tya-ah don't bother us, keeping to their ruins.

Until Darkness came, external thunder did not disturb Howlem's peace. But now...
h: How are my people doing? Do they remember me?

t: Aho, kylys! Although you arrived in the hour of trouble for Howlem, we are glad to see our friends!

Do you want to trade Crystals for gold, or vice versa? I can arrange everything in fine fashion!

Exchange rate is calculated based on the amount of Crystals I currently have. Everything is fare and square - as soon as the rate changes, I'll let you know.

The more Crystals people buy, the higher their price is. And vice versa.

First, choose if you are selling or buying. Enter the required amount, and I will tell you the price in gold. If it is fine with you, confirm the deal and we're agreed!

If the exchange rates change while we are bargaining, I will freeze the deal and tell you the new rate. You will be able to decide if the new rate suits you or not.

Simple, fast and convenient!
Enter the required amount of Crystals.

No!

I mean, yes!

I'm not the leader, I just sit here and observe, I'm not doing anything! Don't kill me! I'll do anything, just don't kill me!
I remember Genlun as if I saw him yesterday! He had a long tail, thick, green and scaly! There was something beside it, but it’s unimportant. The tail!
Well... It's better to regret doing something than not doing something, right?

The flow of time is frozen in this place. Even my heart is quiet, obeying the rhythm of the Planar Rim.

Your enemy is waiting in the middle of the Bridge of Times.

With the death of the Wanderer, time resumes its normal course. The dark skies of Secret Paths are clearing.

The gates of Purgatory are wide open - all you need to do is cross the Bridge of Times.
I am of noble birth, my ancestor was first mentioned in ancient Kanian documents two and a half centuries ago.

It's peaceful...

You know, it makes me want to sing!

Something like "happy birthday", yes. But I'll need something to play the tune. I saw a guy with a harmonica around here. I wonder how people would react to a crocodile with a harmonica?

It's peaceful...

You know, it makes me want to sing!

Something like "happy birthday", yes. But I'll need something to play the tune. I saw a guy with a harmonica around here. I wonder how people would react to a crocodile with a harmonica?

[The pigeon ducks its head and peers at you]

What fang?
h: Where is Fang? He was right there!

t:
Ah, there are so many different guests here, right?

Still, look at this sophisticated gathering. Although I'm surprised to see certain people here.

Ah, there are so many different guests here, right?

I was also invited, of course. Like all the times before. But back then I had other things to do! Fortunately, this year I'm completely free.

Still, look at this sophisticated gathering. Although I'm surprised to see certain people here.

Anyway, it was nice talking to you, . I still need to speak with Catherina about financing her Expedition.

What, you're not a hero anymore?

Everyone turned their back on you? And George knew. He foresaw it... But that’s fine, you can be a hero without all the accolades, right?
It looks like the pigeon is upset. Could it be because you have broken into his home?
The pigeon listens to you patiently, nodding occasionally, then shows you a set of 13 runes, smirking deviously. You would prefer never to see a smirking beak again.
Don’t you think it’s unwise to waste so much experience just to meet me? Keep it.

Ah, that bloodsucker! I’ve heard a lot about him. They say the vampires he sired have a fondness for bears, dogs, squirrels, Cadavers, phantoms, turrets... Well, far be it from me to judge others’ preferences.
The pigeon raises his wing slightly. You can clearly see a few holes about as wide as an arrow shaft.
h: Tell about the scout’s former glory

t: The pigeon leaps away, watching you intently. You have touched him on the raw.
h: Take a feather from George for luck

t: The pigeon looks at you with pity and pointedly unloads a few level 10 artifacts on the table.
h: Invite George to the Observatory to hunt

t: Guests in my nest? Quite peculiar... What made you spend valuable Spark talents on my questionable hospitality?

Well... The weather means a good deal to me. As you could have noticed, I’m a feathered creature, and the clouds play a significant role in my ecosystem. You have no idea how much trouble these feathers give me! But if you really wish to talk about meteorology, I am afraid our discussion might result in a heated argument which can unexpectedly ensue a cognitive dissonance.
Stop smoking this, it’s bad for you, seriously.

You realize I’m a pigeon and have no idea what you’re talking about? The fact that you’re even talking to me is disturbing enough. Your friends are still fighting down there, maybe you should go and give them a hand?
However, I must admit that Klavdia’s curves are quite remarkable.

Nmom nom nemnom monone, me nomi nme mon. Mem mname is Emina, and momam monma.

Emina mana noma mona momo. She nomi momomama nme mona. Momi momo mama nme mon, Emina monone.

quests: Winter Watch: Cones of Good Fortune

t: Dig, you fools! This mountain is full of gold and meteorite, we will be rich! The Empire will never get through the rubble, you hear?!

h: Do you have something for me?

t:
Well, this is sort of unusual... This ship, the Astral. I’m a simple man!

But don't worry, my free hunters are ready to fight! They love a good fight! And since you already saved us once, we are eternally grateful to you! We’ll pass through fire and water for you.

Listen... I wanted to ask you something. See the girl standing over there... Reniesta. Maybe you could help me get to know her, huh? We'll surely get along.
I am a leader, so I should lead! Authority is suffering. It's important for dependability.
Ugh, I could use a break...

I'm sorry, my friend! Alas, nothing ever happens here! The allod is empty and boring, and the only entertainment are your visits that don't happen often...

And I could feel that something special was happening here! As the Village elder, I couldn't just stand by.

It wasn't very nice of me to do that, but I have a solution for you!
h: Erfar? Why were you eavesdropping on us?

t: That Klavdia is a smart one! Alright, let's get down to business...
Listen and memorize: jump three times, then kick up your feet, swing your arm to the north, open your eyes wide...
h: What do I need to do?

t: A harsh fate befell my native Yazes... But who could have known... Dina and I thought that by defeating Urd, we had prevented the worst, but the worst was yet to come...

h: Do you have something for me?

t: Fools! What have you done? The dead have been torn from their graves by the forces of darkness, their rest disrupted... From now on, there are no barriers for those who were outside the world of the living...

h: Do you have something for me?

quests: The Ebb of the Astral Tide
Lesson 1: The sail is your wing!
Leçon 5 : Examen du Maître du vent

t: How do you feel? Dizzy? Do you see multi-colored spots?

We're approaching the wormhole. The ship is nearly falling apart... what the hell is that?

...

Demons! Demons attack!

Damn them, now we have to make a blind jump again. Light save us...

What are you looking at? Hurry to the cannon, shoot them, shoot! We need to break through to the wormhole!

Huh, look who's here! That's one famous warrior here in our ring!

Come here, I'll show you a couple of moves!

We're fighting till five bruises. Bet a copper on your victory – you might just get lucky!
No way, find a copper first.

You're good! The spectators love you.

I could keep on fighting you, but you're already barely standing on your feet. Go get some rest.

Huh, no way! I won't fight you now.

You're way too exhausted. Go get some rest!

Uh. Ahem.

, I believe? I'm very pleased to meet you.

It's amazing to see someone who does so much for our world. Alas, I rarely manage to participate in adventures, unless someone summons me in battle.

However, we are here for a reason, and it's directly related to your actions. You already know about "Gates-3", but the Expedition to another world is being kept secret.

We are going to fund this undertaking because it promises huge profits. This newfangled Ambrosia power engineering is becoming increasingly important, and there are clearly not enough sources of this rare substance. Apparently, they can be found in another world...

Which is how we ended up making the investment. Fortunately, our funds are full at this time, so we were able to allocate the necessary resources.

Hehe, young manlady, it must be hard to hear those unfair words from Aidenus and Yasker? I'll tell you how it is - if anyone is to blame for what happened, it's our, ahem... leaders. And their attempts to push all the blame onto you is them trying to cop out of their responsibility.

I have a business offer. The Tycoon Club has been aiding you for a while, and we recognize that this cooperation has room for further development. Perhaps it's time to leave the service of the inert League or the dogmatic Empire and start working with us? Think about it.

How could we miss such a celebration? Though I see the list of guests is a bit shorter now... Well, I'm sure we'll find something to talk about even with the Gibberlings...

These people are born sailors, and while they spent centuries isolated on Isa, I'm sure they'll get into the swing of it quickly...

We're hiring more crews now - all because of those cursed pirates... Neither the League nor the Empire care about them, and those bastards built ports in the deep Astral and started making forays into our territories. They attack my ships! The gall!
I stand guard! Strange things are happening here, suspicious people lurking about... Watching... Don't give me a reason to get angry! And don't distract me.
I'm Goldhorn, the Minotaur Tribe Chief! We are defenders of the House de Pluie! No one shall pass!
The Pegasus is ready to take you anywhere you want.

Demon reverently nods, greeting you. You realize then that you already met a long time ago - on the Wandering Island.

What is he doing here?

You can see something resembing a grin on Goliath's face.

He must have changed a lot since your last meeting. His anger and blood lust seem to be gone completely. This is surely a good thing, but... Now his striving for the Astral and the Beauty are gone, too.

What keeps Goliath here?

What keeps all Demons here, in Sarnaut?

Goliath shrugs his shoulders. His emotions are clearly readable - disapproval, caution, and... pity? From the depths of your consciousness, fiery letters emerge and arrange themselves into a name - Or'Khan.

Looks like Goliath used to fight alongside him. Now they are leading different paths. Or'Khan just cannot stop. He must destroy, for he cannot live - or BE - otherwise. Then you perceive another message - Goliath wishes you good luck.

Or'Khan must die. It is his fate.
h: Ask about the leader of the invasion

t: You can see outlines of a ghostly figure on the stone... This spirit, trapped by Tep's magis, seems to be trying to tell you something.

Uh, here we meet again, buddy... Yes, I'm sick of that Citadel. Everyday it's demons, vampires, or dragons, and you have to deal with them all...

And I'm just a simple man, even if a ghost. But it looks like our service is over. Now we are going to Jigran. Where will fate take us next? Who knows, who knows...

Ah, once again I find myself without guidance! I'm not good at thinking for myself, I need orders to follow... I suppose I'll have to serve the Mistress of Umoir, get hired as a guard somewhere... I was a voivode in the Settlement... I have some experience! Or maybe Zakh will find me some work for old sake's sake?

I'm a simple man - I became a governor not because I was good at thinking, but because I knew when a punch could solve a problem. And all these speculations only make my head hurt. It's true what they say - if it's too complicated, it can't be good.
I have a feeling we've been watched since the moment we arrived.

quests: A Mystery of the Great Mages

r137048.s: Priest of the Church of Light

t: Greetings! How can I help you?

quests: Find a clearing with nimble hares, catch one of them, then bring it to…

h: Calmly step back and leave the thing alone with its rune
Try to take the rune away. It must belong to you! It will belong to you!

t:
A weird-looking thing with vaguely humanoid features clutches a level 14 rune in its hands, peering at you suspiciously.

- Mine! It’s mine! I spent so much! I lost so much! But it’s mine now! I endured everything! I went though HELL! Bites from Armando’s vampires everywhere... Scars from Areisia’s claws! Why did she have to throw me up in the air?!

And that?! Bruises from Euriala’s bubbles! I swear to the Light, they were harmless at first, and then they started GRINDING THEIR VICTIMS TO A BLOODY PULP.

And you know what this is?! Marks from cursed scouts’ arrows! How could I know a Crippling Shot would cripple my soul?!

Burning arrows... Why, Tensess? Why were trolls, wolves, and hamsters using burning arrows?!

Wolves... Wolves around me, there are screams, blood everywhere, everything is on fire, I’m dying, something’s gnawing at me, and the lion... Why did wolves serve a lion?! That’s not logical!

I remember... Remember a prayer... Everyone is whispering: Lumix Isle... It’s our hope. May we stay on course and reach Lumix Isle... But no. The compass’s cursed arrow turns and... Land of the Thousand Wings. Death, death... Cross, skull, coffin.

My friends... they said it’s going to be fine, everything will work out, but... they... they were engineers. Death! The whole arena is covered in blood! They believed it would be alright... It wasn’t!

But this is all in the past... I have the rune now, and I’m not giving it to you! My... precious.
h: A weird-looking thing with vaguely humanoid features clutches a level 14 rune in its hands, peering at you suspiciously.

quests: Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the Umoir Hunters

t: Do you want to learn a trick? A girl can hop into the arms of her partner. Unless she's one of the gibberlings, of course.
So, steeplejack, shall we blow this place to pieces? Where once was a blockage there'll be a gaping hole, ya dig!
We got out! Now we'll quickly get to the deep Astral and the Seal...

r520364.s: Leader of the Court of Miracles

t:
Oh, I knew we'd see each other again...

 I just didn’t think it would happen so soon. However, I don't think I have a choice. The League and the Empire have failed - let's face it. Now SHE is in charge of everything - and Aidenus and Yasker will dance to her tune.

It doesn't quite suit me, but we have to work with what we have, not what we wish for.

Most likely, if everything goes according to HER plan, there will be no trace of the current states.

Why?

It's simple - if everyone who has ever died is resurrected, most of them have never been subjects of either the League or the Empire in its modern form.

The simplest estimates say that most of the resurrected will be former citizens of the Kanian Empire, the version that existed before the Cataclysm.

Again, why?

It's simple - at that moment the population of our world was the largest, and the old Kania was the most populated state. After the split, most died, and the number of people living since then is nowhere near those values. But that state, just like Xadagan, was much more developed than the primitive kingdoms of the Allods era which rolled back to chivalry and feudalism at first. But... we'll see.

I also understand that you are interested in our contract. It's still valid. You see, SHE released the Sparks from Nihaz's Box. But Nezeb was not in the Box. He is still somewhere out there, in the astral plane. And you will need to find him.
You remember your debt, right? You owe me! Ah, I wish could steal a ship and set sail in search of Nezeb's Spark...
Chronicles lie, just like everything else. History is written in a way that it has its own heroes and villains, but there are no heroes or villains in real life.
Why did you have to blow up the bulwark of Imperial science? Well, I shouldn’t be surprised... Destroying things has become your hobby a long time ago.

I'm glad to see you. Yes, I managed to recover my destiny, and the eternal melancholy that enveloped me has retreated! However, I understand now that I have caused a lot of grief to other living beings… And I feel that I must somehow atone for my actions! Perhaps by doing something for the benefit of others I can earn their forgiveness? In any case, Jigran still needs protection, and I will continue to guard the borders of our settlements...
I think the Dark Maidens are hiding from us now... No, they are still around, and if we wish to find them, we could do so...

Quarr! On behalf of the Summer Feather Tribe, I welcome you at the hour of the brightest suns!

We celebrate the warm summer flame! That is a great Aviak holiday, gratitude for the light and warmth.

The holiday lasts only thirty and one day in July. Then it ends.

While the festival is on, you can take part in it. There is fiery dancing around the fire, and there are water lanterns you can launch. Each activity earns you sparklets, and sparklets are a special currency you can exchange for goods.

Chiki has a friend Juju, the lemur prince who loves dancing. If you trade for him, he might dance with you.
The bonfires are most beautiful at night!

Why you beat Grub? Grub fix the bridge, collect gold! Grub is good!

Used to wave a striped stick to collect gold before. Knights came. Took the stick. Beat Grub. No stick now.

So Grub fix the bridge, take gold. Grub is good!

Share? No share! Mine! Grub built the bridge. Fix the bridge. Why share? All mine.

My bridge! Don’t breake bridge! Grub is good! Alright, I give you half the money!

So what are you going to tell me? Nothing interesting, judging by your face!

Go bother someone else.
Aha! That's right. What does he want?
h: Evil maiden sank to the bottom! Stinky Zho sent me!

t: Who are you? What do you want?
I have no idea! Go look for it in the woods!
Come in, but I’m watching you!

I am Guardian of Cowardice.
Cowardice is a dangerous sin. A coward never receives a friendly handshake, he will be spit at with resent. A coward will betray you, stab you in your back, never fighting face to face. A coward will never perceive the Revelation as he is afraid of the Truth. Overcome your fear!
Only the bravest and the strongest perceive Revelation. Let's begin!

I am Guardian of Greed.
Shining gold and sparkling gems turn heroes mad. A pile of gold kills easier than a blade, gold can break any defenses. Greed pushes people to betrayal, lie and malice. Control your Greed!
Let's see if you can control your Greed!

I am Guardian of Pride.
Pride poisons souls and corrupts hearts. The one who surrenders to Pride overestimates his powers and stumbles where a humble one strides steadily. Control your Pride!

I am Guardian of Sloth.
Sloth is a terrible sin. It is as heavy as a gravestone which pushes you down to earth if you surrender... If you don't bother to sharpen your blade, it can fail you in tomorrow's battle. If you are too lazy to buy healing potions, you will bleed to death from a flesh wound. Control your Sloth!

Stone Golem doesn’t move. There are dead monkeys at its feet. Fresh blood pours from a hole in its chest. Inside, there is a round trinket, that looks much like a hole in June portal. It might help you.
Golem rumbles and starts to move

Huh? What is it? Who are you? I don't remember you.

Shoo from the ship before I whack you on the head! I will count to {num3}!

I don't know how to count further anyway.

t: Greetings from the House de Pluie!

Greetings, !

She's a beautiful vessel, isn't she? Although, she can't compare to the Galleon Castle.

It's lacks luster, I'd say. Too utilitarian. I've been thinking of building something like this, but I'm leaning towards commissioning it from Renard...

But this celebration is top notch. I know what I'm talking about, you see. Happy Anniversary!
Who the Iblis are you? How dare you enter my chambers? Guards! Guards!

What? I was a snake, and all my people were lamias, and you had to fight us? Nonsense. I'm a Sultan's daughter, not a stupid girl who believes in such things.

Guards! Where are you?

What is this green thing outside?
h: Tell the princess about the curse

t: Oh, we brought little ones here, and they ran off again! This ship is so huge, I'm worried I'll never find them!

Oh, I told him that ice floes are tricky! The weather is unstable - we'd have a thaw, then another cold wave... It might look strong, but as you set foot on it, it starts cracking and popping. And without Bear Grease, you shouldn’t even think about going anywhere near the water...
h: I saved your little brother from an ice floe! He is alright.

t: Yes, we'll catch that fish! I swear on my fur - may it fall out if we come back empty-handed today!
Do you think this Eclipse is hard to control? I don't think so - you don't need to hoist sails, just turn the wheel...
The Haregon is eyeing you disdainfully.

Oh, you’re here already? Harmony de Conte, traveling minstrel, at your service!

So he’s our enemy? That’s unfortunate... I’m not sure I can bring myself to harm him. Just look at him! Hasn’t he suffered enough? He hasn’t seen the rays of astral suns or felt the wind on his skin for thousands of years! He’s been breathing dust and fumes... There should be ballads about him!

But I see you want to put an end to his suffering. Well, you may be right: it’s our duty, and death is our job.

I’ve managed to learn something about this poor creature. His sensitive ears are both his weapon and his weakness. He can’t see at all, so he relies on sounds to orient himself. I have a few ideas...
I never thought I'd say this, but you better cover your ears!
h: He hears us! Do something! Play louder!

t: There was a mistake... There was a mistake...
There was a mistake! To continue! Click on enter and return to the window!
h: Ask Harpoon why he killed Shorr.

t:
As you wish... So you want... Wait? So I heard that right?

Oh, my young friend, the joy of my eyes! Thank you! I didn't think anyone would ever waste their wish and free me.

I will no longer be bound to the lamp. I can finally be as far away from it as I want.

It's been a while since I felt that... So many years of service... And finally, I'm free...
h: Hear this, jinn. My wish is... To make you free!

t:
A long time ago, we jinns had our own kingdom hidden behind strong stone walls... There were many kinds of jinns dwelling there in peace and harmony. But one day a powerful sorcerer approached our gates...

He enslaved us, forced us to serve him by chaining us to lamps, pitchers, and rings. We fought wars for him, guarded his treasures. The sorcerer's name was Nezeb.

Even today many of my brethren guard the artifacts buried in the desert... Perhaps it's time they saw the light?

If you want to know more about them - find me in the desert, I'll tell you about them.
h: How did you get bound to the lamp?

t: New master! Well... What is your first wish?

Oh, the wind of my sails, the clouds of my sky! The old jinn is glad to see you on this strange ship that flies through the void.

I see amazing things here. There are many people I once knew but have not seen for many centuries...

Oh, the wind of my sails, the clouds of my sky! The old jinn is glad to see you on this strange ship that flies through the void.

They had been asking me to come here for weeks, but I was afraid to leave Suslanger. Fortunately, your actions have given me enough peace of mind to do it. The evil Ifrits are tamed, and the Orcs, greedy for Nezeb's treasures, are hiding in their junkyard.

That is why I have conjured up the most convincing illusion possible. It will replace me until I return to my sands.

I see amazing things here. There are many people I once knew but have not seen for many centuries...

It was at their instigation – Ur's and Tep's! The psionicists and the mechanics banded together to end the Peraach's reign! Dirty commoners, how dared they?!

The millennium of the Despots' reign was broken, and everything has gone downhill since then...
h: Tell me of how the rebellion against the ruler of Sar-Iram has started?

t: In every murderous glance, there is a hidden story that yearns to be told...

Well then, at last someone found the nerve to pay the old guard a visit! You know, back in my times, we had no tolerance for insolent people like you. But now, I will have to share my memories with you. Open up the Jeb-Flash drive – there's a lot of fascinating stuff... from political intrigue to, ah, intimate liaisons with priestesses. I hope you're ready for some "indecent" stories. And remember: if you think it's going to be easy, clearly you have underestimated the level of our past life!
h: Tell me something new of the times when the rebellion against the ruler of Sar-Iram has started.

t: The last Despot? He wasn't doing anything – except, of course, entertaining himself to drive away the thoughts of death! He had this dissolute Bathory woman elevated, and swelled the ranks of the priests worshipping those elemental gods by offering rich sacrifice! It's not surprising at all that he got himself deposed!
h: Tell me of the uprising during the reign of the last Despot...

t: Every tombstone keeps its own secrets that yearn to be unveiled!

Ah, it's so cute that you came to me now! See, when I was alive, I had so many servants that I didn't even know the names of all of them! And now, I must count on you helping me remember what it was like – to be majestic. Here's the Jeb-Flash drive with my memories – there's a lot of interesting stuff there, from lavish banquets to the... ah, intimate encounters with the rulers of nomes. I hope you're not averse to digging in my past a little...
h: Tell me something new about the times of the last Despot's reign...

quests: Applied Studies: Witnesses of Ancient History

t: Then to the buttcrack with you!

h: Here's a cartridge, let's go to Negus Pilis!

quests: Safe Capital: Path of Fire Heretics
Safe Capital: Path of Ice Heretics
Safe Capital: Cheni and Rutess Gang

t:
Greetings, Child of Sarn.

I'm Heather, the weaving master. I weave clothes and everyday items for other children of All-Mother from the gifts of the Great Tree.

The important thing is that we don't break branches, don't rip bark or leaves, we only collect what falls from the Tree.

I can trade with you if you have special valuables used for exchange with other tribes and aliens. Do you have Tears of All-Mother?outlander
Stormbringer! Have you received my letter?

We are the Heidruns! For millennia we have lived side by side with the Gibberlings, traveling the world and being content with what we have. We hunt and gather the gifts of the earth. We do not create states but live, like in the old days, as a small tribe headed by a leader. Currently that leader is me.

The split of Isa led to the fact that the last tribes of the Heidruns remained with the Great Tree and the Gibberlings. We have suffered greatly from the Urun raids, because these savages use our people for food!

But we don't lose heart. Besides the usual activities, we dance, drink mead, and make love. Heidrun men and women usually get together for one year, and then they look for a new partner. Our offspring are brought up by the entire tribe.

The Gibberlings believe in the all-powerful Fate that weaves its Threads and determines the future.

We worship Luck. Luck favors those she likes. And the best way to endear yourself to Luck is to live as though there is no tomorrow. So we try to live in the present and don't make plans for the future. After all, Luck can suddenly turn away.

Our most important holiday is the birth of a new star in the sky. We call it the Star of Luck and believe that this sign marks a turn for the better.
h: Tell me what you believe in

t: I am the leader of the Heidruns, Tabeko! I welcome you to the Mead Valley...

quests: Day 23: Grain of the Gold from the Past

t: I have given up gambling, and I intend to use my engineering and mathematical knowledge to develop a real game theory and to understand how chance manifests itself in real life!

Ah, thank you for your help... As soon as I got my destiny back, the madness left me...

I have given up gambling, and I intend to use my engineering and mathematical knowledge to develop a real game theory and to understand how chance manifests itself in real life!

Well, of course, I apologized to Lisa and married her. Together we will use the inheritance from the old countess to improve the lives of the people around us...
I watch over other Kobolds, of course! There are many... savages here! They sow discord and confusion! That's why they need someone to watch over them!
Greetings on behalf of all Kobolds!
Hex Zauber, Chancellor for Kobold Affairs. I'm making sure my brethren work together for the good of the House de Desirae.
Zarida? I have no idea what you’re talking about. Svetlana Valir, the wife of that Prince Dakkar, told them about your hideout!
h: How did you find out about the Outpost? Did Zarida tell you?

t:
I saw a threat that can make even mortal enemies stand together.

Those demons... the creatures of darkness. Servants of the Dark God.

We stand for the Light. And they are a much bigger threat than anyone else. We can’t afford to waste our power on lesser threats!

You are also fighting them – so we have a common enemy. But believe me, , as soon as that threat is eliminated, we will remind you of the crimes you have committed.
h: What, Svetlana?! But, uh... Okay, but why did you decide to join us?

t:
! Although we never met, I know a lot about you.

I heard you were a hero of Sarnaut. Were... But who are you now? I’ve heard quite a lot about your exploits. About your... abominable exploits!

I am Hiero, faithful son of our Mother, the Church, which is the Light’s holy bastion! My brethren and I vowed to crusade across Sarnaut to separate the wheat from the chaff, root out vice and wickedness, destroy creatures of the Darkness and bring the Light to the farthest corners...

I learned with sadness of the events unfolding here, and rushed to Umoir. I know everything! And I am ready to make you answer for your deeds! First, you’ll have to give up that disgusting monster you've been hiding. I’m talking about the vampire who  killed so many of our congregation in Wellebell Preserve.

Give my words to Zayan. Either you oblige and give her to us... Or steel shall be our answer!
The Light shines in the darkness and cannot be dimmed...

! We meet again.

I'm here to warn you all. For I believe you are heading straight into the trap of the Dark God. He is cunning, as an owl is cunning in the night. He lies in wait for you on many paths, and very few of those are straight paths.

Everything you have done, everything you have devised - he knew about it in advance, for his capabilities are not the capabilities of mortals, but the powers of God. He persuaded you to do what he wanted with false promises, he put tools in your hands so you could forge your own chain...

Listen to me carefully: I had a vision of what is coming. Sarnaut will become the dominion of Darkness, and Death will rule among the ruins. And you will serve this Death... But in the land that is forgotten, amid ice and fire, there is still hope...

Yes, yes, of course... Remember the secret meeting you escorted me to?

Ah, love is so fickle and fleeting...

Anyway, I gave the artifact to a very sweet Xadaganian - let’s call him “General”.

Back then I already suspected they’d try to steal the artifact from me and decided it would be safe to get it off Irene – just for a while, of course, and by someone no one would suspect.

Well, it seems I was wrong. Eurial was smarter.
h: Louis ordered me to return the artifact to you.

t: Ah, ... I know what you want to talk about.
You did it...! I'm safe! What about my dear George? How is he? Is he okay?
Please tell me you found him! I can't endure Renard's glares any longer, it's like he's trying to set me on fire with his eyes.
But let's not talk about it here... I want you to escort me somewhere, and we can't waste any time!
h: The king said you needed help...

t: All these intrigues are giving me a headache.
Of course! She helped me contact my George... but here on Irene I had to rely on Constance. And you, of course.
h: Antoinette is your friend, so you must have known about her negotiations?

t: , I'm so happy I met you. Have you seen my servant, Constance?

I'm worried about Constance. It's all Eurial's fault! She's the Cardinal's mole.

Antoinette is certain that Renard is plotting something. Did you deliver the letter?
h: Lamias almost got her again. Ivok will take care of her.

t:
Don't worry about that. You're too important to cause my husband's discontent. The truly dangerous one is Eurial!

I don't want Constance to suffer, either.
h: Will the king be angry with me for what I did for you?

t: I'm happy to see you again! What news do you have... good or bad?

How are you, Hero?

Don't you forget - new battles await us. Doesn't have to be between the League and Empire! We have enough enemies.

Today, just enjoy yourself!

How are you, Hero?

Don't you forget - new battles await us. Doesn't have to be between the League and Empire! We have enough enemies. One of them is the Darkness. Darkness of despair. Darkness of impotence. And we are the only ones standing in its way.

I hope you remember that. Or rather, will remember it tomorrow.

Today, just enjoy yourself!

We're on this ship again, !

It's a nice change from Irene... From one holiday to the next... I'm going to go deaf from all the fireworks.

I won't tell you to go have fun. We all remember how that turned out at the Ball. In fact, you should prepare for new feats! Which ones? It's hard to say at this time, but we need to do something about Nihaz, you understand. We defeated him once, but now he's back...

We need to finish this once and for all. How? You'll learn that soon...

! It's good to see you, friend.

Another year has passed, right? It wasn't too difficult, but not completely without challenges. Which you overcame. If everything in the reports I received is true, then it got really hot there on Suslanger. Both literally and figuratively.

You uncovered Nezeb's old secrets, so you must understand why Kania and Xadagan were at each other's throats. We have always been a free state where everyone had a voice in the council.

In the Empire, the word of your superior is law. And it's most noticeable on Suslanger.

Of course, there are times when we work together well. The Great Astral Campaign: yes, from a military point it was pointless, but we learned so much when we fought together.

And now, the pioneers. The idea of sending in more young guys and girls... It's brilliant. I hope they will find common ground. You see, I'm still skeptical about this world. But I'm an old man, a man of the sword, so I still hope the young League members will be able to insert a bit of free-thinking into the minds of their peers from the Empire.

And the Empire will change over time. It will become freer, closer to us.

Quarr! The aircraft will come to Jigran with a sacred mission. All who believe in the light will unite and fight the goddess of Darkness.

The Aviaks will be among them, as we believe in the Light and honor the great Sun which emits Light, generates waves, wind, stone and flame. Soon many warriors will fly in - they will beat up the dead and evil soldiers.
What boring plant life world... thankfully, the war made it more fun.
How dare you cross a goddess?
Damn it! Tep! Liar! Traitor! I... will get to you and send your Spark so far into the abyss that you'll be stuck there until the end of time...

What a bastard! And I gave shelter to that vermin...

Yes, he sucked out some of my strength... Probably most of it. It's time to call Nihaz, but we can't reach him...

Tep has already broken into Eresh and subjugated it - it won't take him long to settle in his new role. After that, he'll be able to kill simply by wishing it.

My little sister is also a treacherous witch, but now Tep poses a significantly greater threat. We'll call it a truce for now.
Excellent! We are in the right place. I have the Seal and the power we harvested.
Yes, it will take some time. Don't let anyone interrupt me, because I'll have to start from the beginning! Be ready to deal with uninvited guests...
Even better! Instead of one Great Mage, we got two. We can return to Jigran.
h: Has everything gone according to plan?

t: If you think I'm just another mindless tyrant and oppressor, then you are stupid. My mission is to stir up your drowsy swamp, and to give you a chance to play with other gods on an equal footing. You have a huge potential, and I will try to unleash it. Of course, sacrifices are inevitable, as are some... difficulties. But the end justifies the means, and all the losses will not be in vain in the end.

My sister can hardly be called brave. However, in this case, she was not afraid. She acted out of calculation, although many would call it cowardice.

But she decided to toy with time. As you understand, Alice is Klavdia, the Klavdia who disappeared from the battlefield and used the Gates to visit the past.

 It all happened in an instant for you, but this sudden opening of the Gates resulted in the release of the All-Mother's power into the past, creating the Ambrosia on Suslanger that you encountered a year earlier.

And now we have a classic case where the future and the past begin to influence each other.
You yourself had a similar experience when you used Gates-2 and stole the Grain of Protopower from Zayan. The snake has bitten its tail, and time forms a closed loop.

Little sister wants to change the future, but it's impossible.

However, I suppose we will see her again when she gets tired of running like a squirrel in a wheel.
h: Why did Klavdia run away from the battle?

t:
What kind of question is that? Nihaz is the god of darkness who has absorbed the power of destruction, death, and other forces, and she is... a simple deity of Life and Creation.

Really, what did you expect from her, what kind of help? It's not even Sarn with his scorching Light which he wielded before his imprisonment and subsequent madness. In the City of Demons, you only saw a faint glimpse of his powers.

The All-Mother, of course, is also capable of punishing her enemies, which she demonstrated to you at the "Trial" arranged for the entertainment of her minions. Surrounded by her adherents and believers, she is much more powerful over there. Of course, if she had been given time, she could have spawned the deities of Light and Order here - defenders who are in fact tyrants...

But we did not give her this chance. Klavdia naively assumed that Nihaz was powerless, but he was ready for the arrival of the All-Mother in Sarnaut. The empty prison became a trap for a god.
h: Why is the All-Mother weaker than Nihaz?

t:
Well, as you can see, I don't waste words. But don't expect everything to be ready in an instant I will indeed resurrect all these poor mortals, but it will take some time - after all, they need bodies that they do not have, and it's not easy to create new ones from nothing. You need a lot of energy... I guess you already know the general principle since you took part in the creation of this Cradle required to open a portal to the Dead City...

It's enough for now that they have been liberated. Little by little, they will be brought back to life - one by one, from the most useful to the ones I don't need at all.

Of course, this does not apply to those who left Sarnaut. Their Sparks can hardly be found now... Although, if we win, resurrection will be granted to all worlds.
h: How does the resurrection of all the dead work?

t: I was once called "Death Incarnate", I walked through other worlds, asserting my father's authority! Begone before I get angry and send your soul to purgatory!
Mistress has chosen me to carry her grace throughout Sarnaut.

After the great Nihaz left his daughter, Hirkalla, to rule Sarnaut and look after its people, much has changed in our world. The dead came to life and flooded the allods, while the Great Mages, who once kept their islands from dissolving into the astral plane, are now looking for ways to unite the world under the leadership of our ruler.

Not everyone accepted these new rules. The deceitful Klavdia, the sister of our Mistress, has hid in the timelines of the past and the future, and now harms our common cause. Therefore, our Darkest Mistress cannot trust just anyone, so she is looking for the most faithful and devoted. Among them is your faithful servant - who has now become her voice, the viceroy in the League and the Empire.

I am instructed to convey her decrees, and you, heroes, are to diligently carry them out. For this you are entitled to a reward - special goods which, by the grace of our Mistress, you can purchase from me.

quests: Hirkalla's Decree: Assault on the Wandering Island

t:
Outlander is always welcome in our land! Not Outlander anymore!

Come at any time! We share food with you!

Not share no women, though. No, no.

You are fine. The Lizardmen know shaman's way. Their connection with spirits is strong. Alas, I am the only one who remains of all Frontier spirits.

It was wise of the horse people from faraway lands to bring you here. I can see the darkness in your soul. But is it wise to banish it?.. The time will show.

If you want to be healed, I can help. A part of my spirit will follow you everywhere. It will help you in the dark hour.

Go without fear, child.
We're all here for the science... and something more than that.

Thank the Fates! I'm glad we're here!

Being part of an epochal event like construction of a Stronghold? I'm beside myself! I'm so proud and happy! Well... yes, I need to pull myself together and focus, yes, yes.

Greetings, traveler. The stars pointed our paths to cross. The luck be on your side, eysh!

I have the most curious items for sale in my bag. Would you like a look?

Blood, blood... blargh... I need blood...

Demons... find demons... drink blood...

Need to... return to the Citadel... Dark tower over the field... Call of destruction...

Give blood! Ugh...

[The drone is trying to relay some message to you, but all you get is interference]

... Come to the Astral Academy...

[Interference]

... Darkness will not...

[Interference]

Last chance...
We need to respect a person! Not feel sorry... Not humiliate them with pity... We should respect them!
I am the master of runes. I know everything there is to know about them and I'd be pleased to share this knowledge with you.
These lands were ours. An ancient pact with darkness. Salvation was close, and we made a deal. It was... the right choice. The right...

h: Do you have something for me?

t: What do you want? My autograph? I can't write, but I can draw a small cross on your hand if you want.
A badge? What badge are you talking about? ...Alright alright, take it!
Creature, we need to establish contact!
The demon is staring at you. After a while, you sense that he tries to communicate something to you. It feels like a consent.
h: Have you seen Centaur the Traveler here?

t: He keeps staring. You see another stream of images. The demon seems to have empathy with the centaur. Is it friendship? Oh no, it's a mixture of feelings. Parting, such sweet sorrow. Appreciation of Centaur's choice. And yes, indeed, the Centaur has left another note.
I love Nikolai Petrovich with all my heart... If I don't love Nikolai Petrovich – then what's the point of living? I only love Nikolai Petrovich in the whole world and will love him forever!

Ah, I'm glad to see you at this celebration, my friend. It may seem that only a couple of years have passed since the Great Ball, but look how much has happened. Changes are brewing in the politics of the Great Houses as old alliances are broken and new ones emerge.

Houses de Delice, Pluie, and Desirae have decided that the future of the Elves lies with the Free Traders. We need a new alliance consisting of free allods that everyone can freely enter. Dane may become the center of it, but the Elves will play a significant role in it.
Dear friend, it's nice to see you at this celebration! The entertainment aboard Catherina's ship may not be the best, but I'm glad to see some of the guests here.

Lots of unusual things are happening in the world! Those who have been forgotten, those who have lost their strength, now awaken again and regain their former power. We are no longer cut off from the flow of sorcery that once created the First. Now these forces are here again, and they fill the ancient gods and spirits... Caw!
h: What are your thoughts on what happened?

t: The raven wants to find those who were lost! The spirits of Howlem that gave their power to the squirrel are not the only ones to be brought back. We can catch the wind that swells the sails of all who once bore the name of the First. They will return - both good and evil, and even those who do not care. But we will find them... Caw!
For centuries, the First, of which there are so few, have been waiting for the fate of Isa to change... Perhaps we will now see those whom we have lost? Caw!
Carr! One who is black as a raven hides their black thoughts under their blackness!

The Doolga say we must shut ourselves in this Holy Land. The source of the power of the Illuminated is here, the thread that led to Howlem.

The eyes of all Sarnaut are fixed on this place. But this land is foreign to us. The spirits of these lands see us as strangers, and hunhurrs are not afraid of us, eysh.

The Doolga know what to do.

We must prove ourselves. To show the spirits of this earth who we are and what we stand for.

So we're going on the Great Hunt. We will strike down the most majestic animals of this land, we will prove that the Pridens are hunters, not prey.

Will you take part in this Hunt?
